credit.credit-words: Are You Sheltered in the Cross?
WORDS and MUSIC: Daniel O. Teasley, pub.1907. Public Domain.

If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me. Lk. 9:23 For the preaching of the cross is... unto us... the power of God. 1 Cor. 1:18 I... glory... in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ. Gal. 6:14
